physics_chapters.title: Light – Reflection and Refraction
core_domains: Spherical mirrors (concave and convex)
Cartesian sign convention (New Cartesian Sign Convention)
Mirror formula and linear magnification
Laws of refraction and absolute refractive index
Refraction through rectangular glass slab and optical density
Refraction by spherical lenses (convex and concave)
Lens formula and magnification
Power of a lens (dioptres)

physics_chapters.title: The Human Eye and the Colourful World
core_domains: Structure and function of human eye and accommodation
Defects of vision: Myopia, Hypermetropia, Presbyopia and their ray diagram corrections
Refraction of light through a triangular glass prism
Dispersion of white light and rainbow formation
Atmospheric refraction: twinkling of stars, advanced sunrise and delayed sunset
Scattering of light: Tyndall effect, colour of clear sky, reddish sky at sunrise/sunset

physics_chapters.title: Electricity
core_domains: Electric current and circuit definitions (I = Q/t)
Electric potential and potential difference (V = W/Q)
Circuit diagram symbols and measurement instruments (Ammeter, Voltmeter)
Ohm's law (V = IR) and V-I characteristics
Resistance and factors affecting resistance (R = rho * L / A)
Resistors in series (R_s = R1 + R2 + R3) and voltage division
Resistors in parallel (1/R_p = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3) and current division
Heating effect of electric current (Joule's law: H = I^2 R t)
Electric power (P = VI = I^2 R = V^2 / R) and commercial unit of electrical energy (kWh)

physics_chapters.title: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
core_domains: Magnetic field and field lines properties (closed continuous loops, non-intersecting)
Oersted's discovery: magnetic field due to current-carrying straight conductor
Right-Hand Thumb Rule (direction of field lines)
Magnetic field due to circular loop and cylindrical solenoid
Electromagnet vs permanent bar magnet
Force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field
Fleming's Left-Hand Rule (motor effect: force, field, current)
Domestic electric circuits (live, neutral, earth wires, grounding, fuse, overloading, short circuiting)
